result.summary: The page is mostly intact but shows visual breakage: misaligned card in 'Fastest near you', truncated restaurant name clipped at the edge, and bottom popular card clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' row is vertically offset lower than the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccolo' cards, breaking top alignment of the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top baseline with consistent image height, card spacing and vertical positioning.

issues.description: The third carousel title is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the screen edge and its '20-30 min' badge is clipped without ellipsis or end padding.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis and end padding for the horizontal scroll list so off-screen cards are not hard-clipped.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is flush against and clipped by the bottom tab bar with no content padding, hiding its title and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and respect safe-area above the tab bar so list items scroll fully into view and are not obscured.
